pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Præcipe filiis Israël, ut ejiciant de castris omnem leprosum,
“Instruct the sons of Israel to cast out of the camp every leper,
and those who have a flow of seed,
and those who have been polluted because of the dead;
tam masculum quam feminam ejicite de castris,
cast out of the camp both male and female,
ne contaminent ea cum habitaverint vobiscum.
lest they contaminate it while I am dwelling with you.”
And the sons of Israel did so,
and they cast them out, beyond the camp,
just as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
when they have done anything out of all the sins that often befall men,
et per negligentiam transgressi fuerint mandatum Domini,
they have transgressed the commandment of the Lord,
and so have committed an offense,
and they shall restore the principle itself,
plus a fifth part above it,
to any against whom they have sinned.
Sin autem non fuerit qui recipiat,
But if there would be no one to receive it,
they shall give it to the Lord,
and it shall be for the priest,
in order to be a pleasing victim.
which the sons of Israel offer,
et quidquid in sanctuarium offertur a singulis,
with whatever is offered by each one at the Sanctuary,
and which is delivered into the hands of the priest;
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
and you shall say to them:
The man whose wife will have gone astray,
will have slept with another man,
et hoc maritus deprehendere non quiverit,
and if her husband cannot discover it,
and if it cannot be proved by witnesses,
quia non est inventa in stupro:
because she was not caught in the shameful act,
si spiritus zelotypiæ concitaverit virum contra uxorem suam,
if the spirit of jealousy stirs up the husband against his wife,
or is being assailed with a false suspicion,
he shall bring her to the priest,
and he shall offer an oblation for her,
a tenth part of native barley meal.
He shall not pour oil over it,
nor shall he place frankincense on it,
because it is a sacrifice for jealousy,
Therefore, the priest shall offer it,
and he shall set it in the sight of the Lord.
assumetque aquam sanctam in vase fictili,
And he shall take up holy water in an earthen vessel,
et pauxillum terræ de pavimento tabernaculi mittet in eam.
and he shall cast a little earth from the pavement of the tabernacle into it.
Cumque steterit mulier in conspectu Domini,
And while the woman stands before the Lord,
et ponet super manus illius sacrificium recordationis,
and he shall place over her hands the sacrifice of recollection
But he shall take hold of the most bitter waters,
in quibus cum execratione maledicta congessit.
in which he has gathered curses with loathing.
And he shall bind her by an oath,
Si non dormivit vir alienus tecum,
and he shall say: ‘If another man has not slept with you,
et si non polluta es deserto mariti thoro, non te nocebunt aquæ istæ amarissimæ,
and if you have not been polluted by forsaking the bed of your husband, these most bitter waters,
into which I have gathered curses, shall not harm you.
Sin autem declinasti a viro tuo,
But if you have turned away from your husband,
and have lain together with another man,
these curses shall be thrown upon you:
det te Dominus in maledictionem, exemplumque cunctorum in populo suo:
May the Lord turn you into a curse and an example among all his people.
May he cause your thigh to rot,
and may your abdomen swell up and burst out.
Ingrediantur aquæ maledictæ in ventrem tuum,
May the cursed waters enter into your stomach,
and may your womb swell and your thigh rot.’
Scribetque sacerdos in libello ista maledicta,
And the priest shall write these curses in a little book,
and then he shall erase them with the very bitter waters,
into which he had gathered the curses,
and he shall give it to her to drink.
And when she has emptied it,
tollet sacerdos de manu ejus sacrificium zelotypiæ,
the priest shall take from her hand the sacrifice of jealousy,
and he shall elevate it before the Lord,
and he shall impose it upon the altar.
pugillum sacrificii tollat de eo, quod offertur,
takes a handful of the sacrifice from that which is offered,
and burns it upon the altar,
et sic potum det mulieri aquas amarissimas.
and then he may give the most bitter waters to the woman as a drink.
is guilty of adultery, the curse shall pass through her,
and as her belly swells up,
eritque mulier in maledictionem, et in exemplum omni populo.
and the woman shall become a curse and an example to all the people.
But if she has not been defiled,
This is the law for jealousy.
Si declinaverit mulier a viro suo,
If a woman has turned aside from her husband,
and if she has been polluted,
maritusque zelotypiæ spiritu concitatus adduxerit eam in conspectu Domini,
and if the husband, being stirred up by the spirit of jealousy, has brought her before the sight of the Lord,
et fecerit ei sacerdos juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt:
and the priest has acted toward her according to all that has been written:
then the husband shall be without guilt,
and she shall bear her iniquity.”
